branchName.instructions: Use `<type>/<short-kebab-slug>`, where type is a Conventional Commits type (feat, fix, refactor, perf, docs, test, build, ci, chore).

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional Commits: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>` in English, imperative, lowercase summary, no trailing period. Scope is the plugin directory name (e.g. `feat(<plugin>): ...`); omit it for repo-wide changes. Mark breaking changes with `!` after the scope.

pullRequest.instructions: The title becomes the squash commit on main, so it must be a Conventional Commits message: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`, scope = plugin directory name, `!` for breaking changes. The body explains what changed and why, in English.
